notes: Born 16 Jul 1907 in Illinois (Urbana, by her obituary), daughter of Cecil Oran Worley and Bessie May Parsons, with whom she was at Kerr Township, Champaign County, in 1910 (census; Social Security index). Married Nelson Hobart Mineer about 1926 and had Lyle, Nancy, Dale and Maragen; at Urbana Township in 1940.

Divorced by April 1950, when she was farming in Franklin County, Washington, with her daughter Marajen, 14 (1950 census). She died at Kennewick on 10 Mar 1989, a resident of Pasco, aged 81, and is buried at Desert Lawn Memorial Park, Kennewick (Washington death record; Find a Grave).
